title: Runtime scale
statement: For a deterministic Goldreich–Levin input with dimension $n$, Fourier bound $B$, and learning parameter $ho$, define its runtime scale to be $\frac{(n+1)(B+1)}{\rho}$.
caveat: The referenced learning parameter is not defined in the supplied material; the formula also relies on that parameter being nonzero for the real quotient to be defined.
